Aphelios.build: Buy Cloth Armor early to help you survive, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Aphelios deals mostly physical damage, and Jinx has low armor, so build armor first. If the enemy team has a lot of healing, consider Executioner's Calling after completing one core item.
Aphelios.combo: If you can build minigun attack speed stacks with basic attacks before a fight, do so. Slow Aphelios with Jinx W Zap!, then attack from range with Jinx Q Switcheroo! rockets. If he gets close, block his approach with Jinx E Flame Chompers! and switch Q to the minigun.
Aphelios.escape: Look to close the distance after Aphelios’s Gravitum root is down and while he isn’t holding Severum. Aphelios has no ability to create distance, so if you get close, pin him down with Jinx E Flame Chompers!. Jinx also has no ability to escape on her own, so don’t use E early just to poke.
Aphelios.fight: Check Aphelios’s current weapon and the next one shown in his E slot, then trade when he has a weapon with low immediate damage. Attack from range with Jinx Q Switcheroo! rockets, and switch to the minigun to gain attack speed when Aphelios gets close. Don’t close the distance while he still has a root available.
Aphelios.laning: Early on, focus on safe CS and rocket poke to build your items instead of taking risky trades. Hit minions beside Aphelios with Jinx Q Switcheroo! rockets to poke with the splash damage. Rocket attacks cost mana, so use the minigun for regular CS. Back away to protect your health if marked by Calibrum.
Aphelios.phase: Jinx usually doesn’t get ahead in lane early, so farm safely. In mid-game fights, watch Aphelios’s weapon and look for openings when his immediate damage is low. In the late game, Jinx deals heavy damage with core items, and a takedown that triggers Jinx P Get Excited! can carry you into the next fight.
Aphelios.teamfight: At the start of a teamfight, poke from the edge with Jinx Q Switcheroo! rockets and Jinx W Zap!, and don’t enter minigun range until it’s safe. Spread out from allies to avoid multiple people being hit by Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil. Set Jinx E Flame Chompers! in advance in narrow paths near objectives to block an engage. Finish off low-health enemies fleeing at a distance with Jinx R Super Mega Death Rocket!.
Aphelios.watch: If Aphelios slows you with a Gravitum basic attack, move out of range before Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites roots you. Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil explodes when it hits a champion, then triggers one extra attack from his main weapon against every champion hit, so spread out from allies when he can use it. If marked by Calibrum, back away, since Aphelios can hit you from beyond his normal range.

Ashe.build: Buy Cloth Armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Ashe deals mostly physical damage, and Jinx has low armor, so build armor first.
Ashe.combo: After dodging Ashe W Volley, slow her with Jinx W Zap! and attack from range with Jinx Q Switcheroo! rocket attacks. If you get an angle to reach Ashe, block her escape route with Jinx E Flame Chompers!. Switch to the minigun when she gets close.
Ashe.escape: Look for an opening after Ashe W Volley is down and Ashe Q Ranger's Focus has worn off. If Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is down too, you can look for an angle to reach Ashe without worrying about the stun. Ashe has no way to create distance, so block her path with Jinx E Flame Chompers!.
Ashe.fight: Trade after Ashe W Volley is down and Ashe Q Ranger's Focus has worn off. Attack from range with Jinx Q Switcheroo! rockets, then switch to the minigun for attack speed if Ashe gets close.
Ashe.laning: Early on, farm safely and build items rather than taking risky trades. When poking, hit minions beside Ashe with Jinx Q Switcheroo! rockets; use the minigun for regular CS to save mana. Plan your recall before you run out of mana.
Ashe.phase: Jinx usually doesn’t get ahead in lane early, so focus on safe CS and rocket poke. In the mid game, work toward your core items; Jinx becomes much stronger in the late game with items. After winning a fight, use Jinx P Get Excited! to move on to the next objective.
Ashe.teamfight: At the start of a teamfight, poke from the edge with Jinx Q Switcheroo! rockets and Jinx W Zap!, and don’t approach with the minigun until it’s safe. Position carefully around Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow. If you get a chance to reach Ashe, block her escape route with Jinx E Flame Chompers!. Finish off enemies fleeing at a distance with Jinx R Super Mega Death Rocket!.
Ashe.watch: Ashe W Volley is a cone-shaped slow, so dodge it by moving sideways. Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow flies in a straight line and stuns, so don’t start a skirmish from out of vision while her ultimate is available; change direction to dodge it when it comes. Keep your distance while Ashe Q Ranger's Focus is active.

Caitlyn.build: Buy Cloth Armor early to help you survive, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Caitlyn’s main damage is physical, so build armor first, while watching your pathing to avoid traps.
Caitlyn.combo: If a fight looks likely, attack minions to build Jinx Q Switcheroo!’s minigun attack speed stacks in advance. Switch to the minigun when the enemy gets close.
Caitlyn.escape: Check your route to avoid Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap before going in, then root her with Jinx E Flame Chompers!.
Caitlyn.fight: Look for a trade right after Caitlyn uses Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker to clear the wave.
Caitlyn.laning: While Caitlyn is strong early, prioritize safe CS over risky trades; it’s fine to hold out under your turret. Only switch Jinx Q Switcheroo! to rockets when poking, hitting minions beside Caitlyn. Use the minigun for regular CS to save mana.
Caitlyn.phase: Caitlyn is strong in the early laning phase, so focus on CS and items without giving up kills. This matchup gets better over time, and Jinx grows stronger with each core item. In the late game, use Jinx P Get Excited! after a won fight to move on to the next objective.
Caitlyn.teamfight: At the start of a teamfight, poke from the edge with Jinx Q Switcheroo! rockets and Jinx W Zap!. Don’t approach with the minigun until you know it’s safe, and save Jinx E Flame Chompers! to protect yourself. Finish off enemies who have lost health fleeing at a distance with Jinx R Super Mega Death Rocket!.
Caitlyn.watch: If Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap roots you, you take heavy damage from Caitlyn P Headshot with its increased range. Expect traps in brush and narrow paths, and change your approach route. Stand behind allied minions to avoid Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker poke.

Draven.build: Buy Cloth Armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Prioritize armor since Draven’s main damage is physical, and keep enough health to get out of the execution range of Draven R Whirling Death.
Draven.combo: Fire Jinx W Zap! where Draven will go to catch an axe to slow him. Attack from range with Jinx Q Switcheroo! rocket attacks, then switch to the minigun for attack speed if Draven gets close. To block his engage, place Jinx E Flame Chompers! where an axe will land or along Draven’s path.
Draven.escape: Look to close the distance when Draven E Stand Aside is down and Draven Q Spinning Axe is down to one or fewer axes. Draven has no ability to create distance, so when you get close, pin him down with Jinx E Flame Chompers! to stop him from escaping.
Draven.fight: Don’t fight back while Draven has two axes from Draven Q Spinning Axe. Fire Jinx W Zap! or place Jinx E Flame Chompers! where an axe will land to make it harder for him to catch it. Try to trade when he has one or fewer axes.
Draven.laning: Farm safely early, and switch to Jinx Q Switcheroo! rockets only when poking. Hit minions beside Draven with rockets to aim for splash damage, and use the minigun for regular CS to save mana. If trading is difficult, farm without giving up a kill, and look to punish Draven when he steps up with your jungler.
Draven.phase: Draven’s axes deal heavy damage early, so Jinx should farm safely to reach item spikes sooner. In the mid game, work with your team to punish Draven when he’s alone, while avoiding deaths. In the late game, Jinx deals heavy damage with core items, so after winning a teamfight, use Jinx P Get Excited! to move on to the next objective.
Draven.teamfight: At the start of a teamfight, poke from the edge with Jinx Q Switcheroo! rockets and Jinx W Zap!. Use Jinx W Zap! or Jinx E Flame Chompers! where Draven’s axes will land to disrupt his catches. Don’t approach with the minigun until you’re sure it’s safe.
Draven.watch: Early on, Draven’s empowered basic attacks hit hard while he’s holding two axes from Draven Q Spinning Axe, so avoid trading. Watch for the displacement and slow from Draven E Stand Aside. After dodging Draven R Whirling Death, stay clear of its return path too.

Ezreal.build: Build Jinx’s core items first to increase her late-game damage. Jinx’s main physical damage is effective against Ezreal’s low armor. If you need defense, choose resistances with both Ezreal Q Mystic Shot’s physical damage and the magic damage from Ezreal W Essence Flux and Ezreal E Arcane Shift in mind.
Ezreal.combo: Poke with the slow from Jinx W Zap! and Jinx Q Switcheroo! rocket attacks to draw out Ezreal E Arcane Shift. Once his mobility is down, place Jinx E Flame Chompers! in his escape route and deal damage from rocket range. If Ezreal gets close, switch Jinx Q Switcheroo! to the minigun.
Ezreal.escape: Right after Ezreal uses Ezreal E Arcane Shift is your window to close the distance. Use Jinx E Flame Chompers! to block his escape route, but don’t keep getting hit by Ezreal Q Mystic Shot and let his mobility come back faster.
Ezreal.fight: While Ezreal E Arcane Shift is available, keep your distance and poke briefly with Jinx Q Switcheroo! rockets and Jinx W Zap!. Once he uses Ezreal E Arcane Shift, block his escape route with Jinx E Flame Chompers!, close the distance, and fight. If he gets close, switch Jinx Q Switcheroo! to the minigun for more attack speed.
Ezreal.laning: Move with minions between you and Ezreal to block Ezreal Q Mystic Shot. When poking, hit minions beside Ezreal with Jinx Q Switcheroo! rockets to deal splash damage. Use the minigun for regular CS to save mana. Focus on safe CS and core items over risky trades.
Ezreal.phase: Early on, Jinx isn’t a champion who gets ahead in lane, so farm behind minions while dodging Ezreal’s poke. In the mid game, choose fights based on your core items and whether Ezreal E Arcane Shift has been used. In the late game, Jinx’s damage rises sharply with core items, so after winning a teamfight, use the movement and attack speed from Jinx P Get Excited! to move on to the next objective.
Ezreal.teamfight: At the start of a teamfight, poke from the edge with Jinx Q Switcheroo! rockets and Jinx W Zap! while staying in a safe position. If Ezreal E Arcane Shift is down and an opening to engage appears, block his escape route with Jinx E Flame Chompers!. Try to finish off low-health enemies fleeing at a distance with Jinx R Super Mega Death Rocket!.
Ezreal.watch: Dodge Ezreal Q Mystic Shot by keeping minions between you and him, and remember that repeated hits make Ezreal E Arcane Shift’s cooldown come back faster. If Ezreal W Essence Flux attaches to you, briefly move out of range to avoid the follow-up damage. When your health is low, watch for Ezreal R Trueshot Barrage: don’t line up with allies, and retreat along terrain.

Jhin.build: Buy Cloth Armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Jhin deals mostly physical damage, and Jinx has low armor, so build armor first.
Jhin.combo: Before a fight, attack minions with the minigun to build Jinx Q Switcheroo! attack speed stacks. After dodging Jhin W Deadly Flourish or while Jhin is reloading, slow him with Jinx W Zap! and attack from range with rockets. If Jhin gets close, root him with Jinx E Flame Chompers! and switch to the minigun.
Jhin.escape: Close the distance when Jhin W Deadly Flourish has missed and he is reloading. Jhin has no ability to create distance, so look for a chance to root him with Jinx E Flame Chompers! once you’re close.
Jhin.fight: Trade while Jhin is reloading or after he has fired one or two shots, and back away if he still has his final shot. Slow him with Jinx W Zap!, then keep your distance with Jinx Q Switcheroo! rocket attacks. If Jhin gets close, switch Jinx Q Switcheroo! to the minigun for attack speed.
Jhin.laning: Hit minions beside Jhin with Jinx Q Switcheroo! rockets to poke with splash damage. Use the minigun for regular CS to save mana, and don’t stand next to low-health minions because of Jhin Q Dancing Grenade. Focus on safe CS and building items over risky trades.
Jhin.phase: Early on, focus on rocket poke and safe CS instead of trying to get ahead in lane. In the mid game, work toward core items rather than taking risky fights. Jinx grows stronger with items in the late game, and a takedown that triggers Jinx P Get Excited! can help you carry a won fight forward.
Jhin.teamfight: While your frontline goes in first to absorb Jhin W Deadly Flourish and Jhin R Curtain Call shots, poke from the edge with rockets and Jinx W Zap!. Place Jinx E Flame Chompers! in narrow approach routes, and don’t enter minigun range until it’s safe. Jhin R Curtain Call is more dangerous when your health is low, so focus on dodging if you aren’t at full health.
Jhin.watch: Jhin P Whisper’s final shot deals heavy damage, so back away while he still has it. After Jhin’s basic attack hits you or you step on Jhin E Captive Audience, move to dodge the narrow, straight root from Jhin W Deadly Flourish. Jhin Q Dancing Grenade can grow stronger as it bounces through targets it kills, so stay away from low-health minions. If your health is low, focus on dodging Jhin R Curtain Call.

Kaisa.build: Buy Cloth Armor early to help you survive, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Build armor first since Kai'Sa’s main damage, including Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain, is physical. Armor won’t block the magic damage from Kai'Sa P Second Skin or Kai'Sa W Void Seeker.
Kaisa.combo: Slow Kai'Sa with Jinx W Zap!, then deal damage from range with Jinx Q Switcheroo! rocket attacks. If she gets close, switch Jinx Q Switcheroo! to the minigun. If Kai'Sa dives in with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct, root her with Jinx E Flame Chompers! to stop her follow-up attacks.
Kaisa.escape: If you root Kai'Sa with Jinx E Flame Chompers! then, she can’t escape with her ultimate dash. If Kai'Sa W Void Seeker has hit you and its mark remains, back away first and wait for it to disappear.
Kaisa.fight: Poke with rockets. If a fight looks like it will last, attack minions to build minigun attack speed stacks in advance. If Kai'Sa gets close, switch Jinx Q Switcheroo! to the minigun to make use of the attack speed.
Kaisa.laning: Early on, push the lane to pressure Kai'Sa’s CS and health, but prioritize safe CS over risky trades. Hit minions beside Kai'Sa with Jinx Q Switcheroo! rockets to poke with splash damage. Use rockets only to poke, and the minigun for regular CS to save mana.
Kaisa.phase: Pressure Kai'Sa’s CS and health with rocket poke. After that, focus on safely building core items instead of taking risky fights. Jinx gets stronger with items in the late game, and if a won fight triggers Jinx P Get Excited!, you can carry that momentum to the next objective.
Kaisa.teamfight: At the start of a teamfight, poke from the edge with Jinx Q Switcheroo! rockets and Jinx W Zap!, then attack with the minigun when it’s safe. If Kai'Sa dives in with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct, root her immediately with Jinx E Flame Chompers!. Kai'Sa can appear from the flank with Kai'Sa E Supercharge, so place Control Ward in flank brush and approach routes before a fight.
Kaisa.watch: If Kai'Sa W Void Seeker hits you, its mark can make you a target for Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct. Back toward your allies right away and stay there until the mark disappears. If Kai'Sa looks ready to use Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain, stand near allied minions to spread out its damage. If stacks of Kai'Sa P Second Skin build up, wait out of range for them to expire.

Kalista.build: Kalista's main damage is physical, and Jinx has relatively low armor, so build armor first. Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Kalista W Sentinel's damage is not blocked by armor, so don't rely on simply stacking a lot of health.
Kalista.combo: Read when Kalista is preparing an attack, slow her with Jinx W Zap!, then look to root her with Jinx E Flame Chompers! Keep your distance and attack with rocket autos from Jinx Q Switcheroo!, switching to the minigun when Kalista gets close. If a fight is likely, attack minions beforehand to build minigun attack speed stacks.
Kalista.escape: While Kalista R Fate's Call is down, you have less need to watch for her throwing her support in to engage, so look for a chance to catch her with Jinx E Flame Chompers! Be mindful of the slow and stacking damage from Kalista E Rend; don't engage while several spears are stuck in you.
Kalista.fight: Kalista P Martial Poise lets her hop only after she starts an attack, so read her attack windup and look for a chance to hit her with Jinx W Zap! or Jinx E Flame Chompers! Initially, keep your distance and attack with the rockets from Jinx Q Switcheroo!; when Kalista gets close, switch to the minigun to increase your attack speed.
Kalista.laning: Focus on safe CS and rocket poke with Jinx Q Switcheroo! rather than forcing trades early. Rocket attacks on a minion next to the enemy champion can poke with splash damage while avoiding minion aggro. Use the minigun for regular last hits to save mana, and briefly leave lane if Kalista has stuck several spears in you.
Kalista.phase: Jinx has a hard time getting ahead in lane early, so farm safely and build items. In the mid game, focus on poking from range and positioning safely instead of forcing fights. Jinx gets strong in the late game as her core items come together; if a takedown triggers Jinx P Get Excited!, carry the won fight into the next objective.
Kalista.teamfight: At the start of a teamfight, poke from the edge with Jinx Q Switcheroo! rockets and Jinx W Zap!, and don't enter minigun range until you're sure it's safe. Spread out and prepare Jinx E Flame Chompers! for the expected landing spot of the support Kalista R Fate's Call will throw. Look for a chance to finish off a low-health enemy fleeing at long range with Jinx R Super Mega Death Rocket!
Kalista.watch: Kalista E Rend can deal heavy damage after several spears are stuck in you, so if stacks have built up, break off the fight and back away until the spears disappear. Kalista R Fate's Call throws her support in to engage, so if the support stays close to Kalista, spread out and prepare Jinx E Flame Chompers! at the expected landing spot.

KogMaw.build: Focus on farming safely and building Jinx’s core items. If you need defensive stats, build magic resistance first to guard against Kog'Maw’s ability damage, while also considering the physical damage from his basic attacks.
KogMaw.combo: After Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage ends, slow him with Jinx W Zap! and attack from range with Jinx Q Switcheroo! rocket attacks. When closing in to catch Kog'Maw, root him with Jinx E Flame Chompers!. If he gets close, switch to the minigun.
KogMaw.escape: Kog'Maw has no mobility, so close the distance after Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage ends and you dodge the slow from Kog'Maw E Void Ooze. Save Jinx E Flame Chompers! when going in, then use it on Kog'Maw to stop him from escaping.
KogMaw.fight: Look to trade after Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage ends. Until then, keep your distance with Jinx Q Switcheroo! rocket range, and switch to the minigun to use its attack speed if Kog'Maw gets close.
KogMaw.laning: Hit minions beside Kog'Maw with Jinx Q Switcheroo! rockets to deal splash damage, and use the minigun for regular CS to save mana. Early on, Jinx should prioritize safe farming over risky fights while pressuring Kog'Maw’s farm.
KogMaw.phase: Early on, Jinx should focus on safe CS to reach item spikes sooner rather than forcing a lane advantage. Kog'Maw also grows stronger over time, so look for opportunities to secure objectives and turrets in the early and mid game. In the late game, Jinx can deal damage safely in teamfights with core items, and if a takedown or structure destruction triggers Jinx P Get Excited!, use it to move on to the next objective.
KogMaw.teamfight: At the start of a teamfight, poke from the edge with Jinx Q Switcheroo! rockets and Jinx W Zap!, and don’t enter minigun range until it’s safe. When Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage ends or your allies engage on Kog'Maw, who has no mobility ability, root him with Jinx E Flame Chompers! and focus him down. After killing Kog'Maw, move away from his corpse to avoid the explosion from Kog'Maw P Icathian Surprise.
KogMaw.watch: When Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is active, its range and basic attack damage increase, so keep your distance until it ends. Dodge Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle from behind minions, and avoid fighting if it hits you while your resistances are reduced. When your health is low, watch out for Kog'Maw R Living Artillery and move out of vision. After killing Kog'Maw, walk away from his corpse to dodge the explosion from Kog'Maw P Icathian Surprise.

Lucian.build: Start with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Lucian's main damage is physical, and Jinx has relatively low armor, so build armor first.
Lucian.combo: Attack minions before a fight to build attack speed stacks for the minigun from Jinx Q Switcheroo!. Once Lucian E Relentless Pursuit is down, slow him with Jinx W Zap!, then place Jinx E Flame Chompers! to look for a root, and attack from range with rocket autos. Switch to the minigun if Lucian gets too close.
Lucian.escape: Right after Lucian uses E Relentless Pursuit is your window to close the distance and catch him. If his first combo is also down, block his escape route with Jinx E Flame Chompers! and counterattack.
Lucian.fight: Wait out Lucian's first combo, then counterattack when his abilities are down. Right after he uses Lucian E Relentless Pursuit, slow him with Jinx W Zap! and block his escape route with Jinx E Flame Chompers!.
Lucian.laning: Prioritize safe CS and rocket poke with Jinx Q Switcheroo! over forcing trades early. Rocket attacks on a minion next to the enemy champion can poke with splash damage while avoiding minion aggro. Use the minigun for regular last hits to save mana, and recall before you run out.
Lucian.phase: Jinx isn't a champion who gets ahead in lane early, so use safe CS to reach your item spikes sooner. Keep building items in the mid game and choose fights when Lucian's first combo and mobility spell are down. Jinx gets strong in the late game as her core items come together, and if a takedown triggers Jinx P Get Excited!, you can carry that into the next fight.
Lucian.teamfight: At the start of a teamfight, poke from the edge with Jinx Q Switcheroo! rockets and Jinx W Zap!. Don't go in with the minigun until you're sure it's safe, and save Jinx E Flame Chompers! to protect yourself and stop the enemy engage. Finish off low-health enemies fleeing at long range with Jinx R Super Mega Death Rocket!.
Lucian.watch: Lucian Q Piercing Light passes through minions and reaches farther than its indicator suggests, so avoid standing in a line behind the minion Lucian is farming. Watch out for his first combo when he uses Lucian E Relentless Pursuit to engage. When Lucian uses R The Culling, dodge to the side instead of running straight back. If Lucian receives a shield or healing, or one of your allies becomes immobilized, his next two shots are empowered, so back off briefly.

MissFortune.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Miss Fortune's main damage is physical, and Jinx has relatively low armor, so build armor first.
MissFortune.combo: Slow Miss Fortune with Jinx W Zap!, then attack from range with rocket autos from Jinx Q Switcheroo!. If you can safely close the distance, block her escape route with Jinx E Flame Chompers!, and switch Jinx Q Switcheroo! to the minigun at close range.
MissFortune.escape: Miss Fortune has no mobility, so look for a chance to close the distance after dodging the slow area from Miss Fortune E Make It Rain. When Miss Fortune R Bullet Time starts, first move to the side of its cone, then catch her with Jinx E Flame Chompers! if you can safely approach.
MissFortune.fight: After Miss Fortune attacks a minion, create distance before you get hit by her empowered attack. Don't fight in the area covered by Miss Fortune E Make It Rain; attack from range with Jinx Q Switcheroo! rockets outside it. Once it's safe to close the distance, switch Jinx Q Switcheroo! to the minigun and build attack speed.
MissFortune.laning: Stand beside minions to avoid Miss Fortune Q Double Up while farming safely. To poke, use a rocket auto from Jinx Q Switcheroo! on a minion next to the enemy champion to deal splash damage. Use the minigun for regular last hits to save mana, and plan your recall before you run out.
MissFortune.phase: Jinx isn't a champion who gets ahead in lane early, so prioritize safe CS while dodging Miss Fortune's poke. Focus on building core items in the mid game, and use Jinx's strength from her items to fight in the late game. If a takedown triggers Jinx P Get Excited!, use the movement and attack speed you gain to pursue the next objective.
MissFortune.teamfight: In teamfights, poke from the edge with Jinx Q Switcheroo! rockets and Jinx W Zap!, and don't go in close until it's safe. Don't fight in an area covered by Miss Fortune E Make It Rain, and dodge to the side of Miss Fortune R Bullet Time's cone. Use Jinx R Super Mega Death Rocket! on a low-health enemy fleeing at long range.
MissFortune.watch: Miss Fortune Q Double Up bounces behind the minion it hits, so don't stand in a line with minions. It's hard to escape Miss Fortune E Make It Rain because of its slow, so move out of the area. When Miss Fortune casts R Bullet Time, dodge to the side of its fixed cone.

Nilah.build: Nilah’s main damage is physical, and Jinx has low armor, so start with Cloth Armor for survivability, then buy Plated Steelcaps. Nilah Q Formless Blade has penetration, so build health as well. If the enemy team has a lot of healing, slot Executioner's Calling in after completing one core item.
Nilah.combo: Before a fight, attack minions to build stacks of Jinx Q Switcheroo!’s minigun attack speed. Slow Nilah with Jinx W Zap!, then attack from a distance with rocket basic attacks. If Nilah closes in with E Slipstream, place Jinx E Flame Chompers! to root her, then resume basic attacking after Nilah W Jubilant Veil ends.
Nilah.escape: Your opening comes after Nilah W Jubilant Veil and Nilah R Apotheosis are down. Nilah E Slipstream has a short cooldown, so don’t close in just because her mobility ability has been used; root her first with Jinx E Flame Chompers!.
Nilah.fight: Before Nilah approaches, use Jinx Q Switcheroo!’s rockets to attack from a distance. When Nilah W Jubilant Veil is active, stop basic attacking and wait for it to end or respond with abilities. If Nilah closes in, trap her with Jinx E Flame Chompers!, and switch Jinx Q Switcheroo! to minigun at close range.
Nilah.laning: Use Jinx Q Switcheroo!’s rockets to hit minions beside Nilah and deal splash damage, but last-hit normally with the minigun to save mana. First priority is denying angles where Nilah E Slipstream can close the gap.
Nilah.phase: In the mid game, focus on getting your core items through safe last-hitting. Jinx gets stronger in the late game as core items stack up. When Jinx P Get Excited! activates from a takedown or turret destruction, quickly move on to the next objective.
Nilah.teamfight: Poke from the edge with Jinx Q Switcheroo!’s rockets and Jinx W Zap!, and don’t go in with the minigun until it’s safe. Keep your distance from allies so multiple players aren’t caught by Nilah R Apotheosis. After Nilah engages and uses Nilah W Jubilant Veil, root her with Jinx E Flame Chompers! to create an opening to attack.
Nilah.watch: Right after Nilah Q Formless Blade hits, her attack area widens, so take one more step back. Watch for Nilah E Slipstream to close the gap, and keep your distance from allies when Nilah R Apotheosis is available.

Samira.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Samira's main damage is physical, and Jinx has relatively low armor, so build armor first.
Samira.combo: Slow Samira first with Jinx W Zap!, then attack from range with rocket autos from Jinx Q Switcheroo!. If Samira activates W Blade Whirl, stop firing projectiles and basic attacks until the spin ends. If she gets close, block her path with Jinx E Flame Chompers!; if she gets too close, switch to the minigun to increase your attack speed.
Samira.escape: Right after Samira uses E Wild Rush is your window to engage. If you root her then with Jinx E Flame Chompers!, it's hard for her to escape. If the enemy still has crowd control available, dodge it first and keep your distance.
Samira.fight: Poke Samira with the range of Jinx Q Switcheroo! rockets as she walks in, and don't fight in melee range for long. If a fight is likely, attack minions beforehand to build minigun attack speed stacks. If Samira has engaged with E Wild Rush and nobody has died, that's your chance to root her with Jinx E Flame Chompers! and counterattack.
Samira.laning: Focus on safe CS and rocket poke to reach your items sooner instead of forcing trades early. If Samira is beside a minion, use a rocket from Jinx Q Switcheroo! on that minion to aim for splash damage. Use rockets only to poke, and use the minigun for regular last hits to save mana.
Samira.phase: Jinx isn't a champion who gets ahead in lane early, so farm safely. In the mid game, keep fighting at rocket range so Samira can't get close and build style. Jinx gets stronger as her core items come together in the late game, and if a takedown triggers Jinx P Get Excited!, you can carry that into the next fight.
Samira.teamfight: Poke from the edge of a teamfight with rockets from Jinx Q Switcheroo! and Jinx W Zap!, and don't enter minigun range until it's safe. If an ally is caught by enemy crowd control, anticipate Samira P Daredevil Impulse's dash and place Jinx E Flame Chompers! in Samira's path. When Samira R Inferno Trigger starts, look for a chance to interrupt it with the root from Jinx E Flame Chompers!.
Samira.watch: While Samira W Blade Whirl is active, it destroys projectiles and basic attacks, so use Jinx W Zap! and rocket autos after the spin ends. If you are hit by enemy crowd control, Samira P Daredevil Impulse can let her close in immediately, so dodge engage abilities that start near Samira. It's important not to give up distance, since Samira R Inferno Trigger keeps dealing damage and healing while she stays close.

Senna.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Senna's main damage is physical, and Jinx has relatively low armor, so build armor first. If the enemy team has a lot of healing, fit Executioner's Calling in after completing one core item.
Senna.combo: When Senna steps forward, slow her with Jinx W Zap! and attack from range with rocket autos from Jinx Q Switcheroo!. You can also hit a minion beside Senna with a rocket to poke her with splash damage. When you have a chance to close the distance and catch her, root her with Jinx E Flame Chompers!; switch to the minigun to keep attacking at close range.
Senna.escape: After Senna W Last Embrace misses or has been used is your chance to go in while avoiding the root. Senna has no ability to create distance herself, so if you close the gap, use Jinx E Flame Chompers! to root her and stop her from escaping. If Senna E Curse of the Black Mist is active, she gains movement speed and allies within it are camouflaged as they approach, so back off immediately and look for another opening from a position with vision.
Senna.fight: Focus on safe poke with rocket autos from Jinx Q Switcheroo! instead of forcing trades early. When Senna steps forward to collect a soul or after she uses Senna W Last Embrace, slow her with Jinx W Zap! and attack from range. If Senna gets close and you can keep attacking safely, switch Jinx Q Switcheroo! to the minigun.
Senna.laning: Track where Senna's souls are and poke her when she steps forward to collect them, disrupting her collection. If Senna hits you once, back off so you don't let her land a second attack and collect mist. Use rockets from Jinx Q Switcheroo! only to poke, and use the minigun for regular last hits to save mana.
Senna.phase: Senna has low health and attack damage early, but Jinx also isn't a champion who gets ahead in lane, so use safe poke to prevent soul collection and farm CS. In the mid game, look for moments when Senna steps forward so she can't collect souls freely while you build your items. Jinx gets strong in the late game with her core items and passive, but if Senna has collected souls, her range and attack damage also grow, so fight while maintaining your positioning.
Senna.teamfight: At the start of a teamfight, poke from the edge with rockets from Jinx Q Switcheroo! and Jinx W Zap!, and don't go in with the minigun until you're sure it's safe. If you see Senna E Curse of the Black Mist, back off to secure vision or place Jinx E Flame Chompers! in the mist to stop an engage. Finish off low-health enemies fleeing at long range with Jinx R Super Mega Death Rocket!, and if you get a takedown, use the movement and attack speed from Jinx P Get Excited! in the next fight.
Senna.watch: Senna Q Piercing Darkness passes through allies and minions in a straight line, slowing enemies and healing allies. Dodge it by moving out of the line between Senna and the front minion. Senna W Last Embrace roots after a delay when it hits, so dodge it from behind minions and immediately move away from allies if you are marked.

Seraphine.combo: After dodging Seraphine E Beat Drop, slow her with Jinx W Zap! and attack from range with rocket autos from Jinx Q Switcheroo!. If you've closed the distance, root her with Jinx E Flame Chompers!; when Seraphine gets close, switch to the minigun to increase your attack speed.
Seraphine.escape: Engage right after Seraphine E Beat Drop is down. Seraphine has no mobility, so if you close the distance then and root her with Jinx E Flame Chompers!, it's hard for her to escape. If Jinx is being chased, place Jinx E Flame Chompers! on the escape route behind you and slow your pursuer with Jinx W Zap!.
Seraphine.fight: Right after dodging Seraphine E Beat Drop is your chance to close the distance. If Seraphine is alone and separated from her allied marksman, trade with her and use Jinx E Flame Chompers! to stop her escaping. Keep your distance and poke with rocket autos while Seraphine still has her catch ability available.
Seraphine.laning: Focus on safe CS and rocket poke to reach your items sooner instead of forcing trades early. Use rockets from Jinx Q Switcheroo! on a minion next to Seraphine to aim for splash damage, and use the minigun for regular last hits to save mana. Plan your recall before you run out of mana.
Seraphine.phase: Jinx isn't a champion who gets ahead in lane early, so prioritize safe CS. Build core items in the mid game and fight when Seraphine E Beat Drop is down. Jinx gets strong as her items come together in the late game, and if a takedown or structure destruction triggers Jinx P Get Excited!, you can quickly move on to the next objective.
Seraphine.teamfight: At the start of a teamfight, poke from the edge with rockets from Jinx Q Switcheroo! and Jinx W Zap!. Spread out so Seraphine R Encore can't travel through allies and reach the back line. Watch for Seraphine's catch ability and sustain damage with the minigun once it's safe.
Seraphine.watch: Seraphine E Beat Drop roots slowed targets and stuns immobilized targets. If you're slowed, first get out of the straight line in front of Seraphine. Seraphine R Encore gains range each time it hits an allied champion, so don't line up with your allies in teamfights.
Seraphine.build: Jinx farms safely and prioritizes completing her first core item. If you build resistance against Seraphine’s damage, choose magic resistance. If the enemy team has a lot of healing, fit Executioner's Calling in after completing one core item.

Sivir.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Sivir's main damage is physical, so build armor first. If the enemy team has a lot of healing, fit Executioner's Calling in after completing one core item.
Sivir.combo: Bait out Sivir E Spell Shield first, then slow her with Jinx W Zap! and attack from range with rocket autos from Jinx Q Switcheroo!. If Sivir gets close, switch to the minigun; while Sivir E Spell Shield is down, root her with Jinx E Flame Chompers!.
Sivir.escape: The chance to catch Sivir comes when Sivir E Spell Shield is down and Sivir R On The Hunt has ended. Sivir has no ability to create distance herself, so close the gap and block her escape route with Jinx E Flame Chompers!.
Sivir.fight: Focus on keeping your distance and poking with Jinx Q Switcheroo! rockets instead of forcing trades early. Once Sivir E Spell Shield is down, slow her with Jinx W Zap! and attack with rocket autos. If Sivir gets close, switch Jinx Q Switcheroo! to the minigun to increase your attack speed.
Sivir.laning: Use the minigun from Jinx Q Switcheroo! for regular last hits, and switch to rockets only when poking to save mana. When poking with rockets, you can hit a minion beside Sivir to catch her in the splash damage. Sivir clears waves quickly, so if you need to leave lane, push the wave first or make sure an ally is ready to catch it.
Sivir.phase: Jinx isn't a champion who gets ahead in lane early, so farm safely and build items. In the mid game, be mindful of Sivir's fast wave clear and don't leave lane for long. Jinx gets stronger as her core items come together in the late game, and if you get a takedown in a fight and trigger Jinx P Get Excited!, you can quickly move on to the next objective.
Sivir.teamfight: At the start of a teamfight, poke from the edge with rockets from Jinx Q Switcheroo! and Jinx W Zap! while staying in a safe position. If Sivir R On The Hunt is active, take only short fights around terrain and vision, and don't chase until it ends. Once Sivir E Spell Shield is down, look for a chance to catch her with Jinx E Flame Chompers!.
Sivir.watch: Sivir Q Boomerang Blade can hit both on the way out and on the way back, so if you get hit by the first pass, move out of its return path. Sivir E Spell Shield blocks one ability, so check whether it's down before using Jinx W Zap! or Jinx E Flame Chompers!. When Sivir R On The Hunt is active, the entire enemy team moves faster, so avoid chasing or retreating slowly.

Smolder.build: Use Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Prioritize armor against Smolder’s main damage, but keep your health above his execute threshold: armor cannot block the true damage or execute from Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath once he has grown.
Smolder.combo: When a fight looks likely, use Jinx Q Switcheroo!’s minigun on minions to build attack speed stacks in advance. Slow Smolder with Jinx W Zap!, then attack with rocket basic attacks while keeping your distance. If Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is down, root him with Jinx E Flame Chompers!, and switch to the minigun if he gets close.
Smolder.escape: The window to engage opens right after Smolder uses Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap. Block his escape with Jinx E Flame Chompers! and attack. If Smolder W Achooo! slows you, his follow-up attacks are likely to land, so dodge it before closing the distance.
Smolder.fight: Early on, use Jinx Q Switcheroo!’s rockets to poke safely and disrupt Smolder’s farming. Right after Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is down, block his escape with Jinx E Flame Chompers!, keep your distance, and attack. If Smolder gets close, switch Jinx Q Switcheroo! to the minigun to increase your attack speed.
Smolder.laning: Dodge Smolder’s poke and disrupt his CS so he cannot grow by hitting champions with abilities or killing enemies with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath. Use Jinx Q Switcheroo!’s rockets to hit minions beside Smolder and deal splash damage, but use the minigun for ordinary CS to save mana. Dodge Smolder W Achooo! while securing safe CS, and look for chances to pressure him with your jungler in the early and mid game.
Smolder.phase: Smolder is weakest early, but Jinx should also focus on safe rocket poke and securing CS rather than forcing trades. In the mid game, take turrets and objectives before Smolder gains more permanent growth stacks to snowball the game. In the late game, Jinx gains more ability to carry a teamfight forward with core items and her passive, but Smolder becomes more favored as the game goes on, so it is important to prevent him from scaling.
Smolder.teamfight: At the start of a teamfight, poke from the edge with Jinx Q Switcheroo!’s rockets and Jinx W Zap!, and don’t enter minigun range until it’s safe. Save Jinx E Flame Chompers! for self-protection, then use it to root Smolder after Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is down. Get out of the flames from Smolder R MMOOOMMMM!, and finish off low-health enemies fleeing at a distance with Jinx R Super Mega Death Rocket!.
Smolder.watch: Smolder W Achooo! explodes when it hits a champion, granting growth stacks and slowing them, so stand behind minions or dodge to the side. Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is his only escape that crosses terrain, so track whether he has used it. Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! deals heavy damage at its center and heals Smolder, so leave the flames, then re-engage.

Tristana.combo: Slow Tristana first with Jinx W Zap!, then attack from range with rocket autos from Jinx Q Switcheroo!. If Tristana engages with W Rocket Jump, place Jinx E Flame Chompers! in her path to look for a root. If she gets close, switch Jinx Q Switcheroo! to the minigun to increase your attack speed.
Tristana.escape: Right after Tristana uses W Rocket Jump is your chance to close the distance. If you catch her then with Jinx E Flame Chompers!, Tristana can't escape with W Rocket Jump. If Tristana R Buster Shot is still available, engage while watching for its forced displacement.
Tristana.fight: Keep your distance and poke with Jinx Q Switcheroo! rockets while Tristana W Rocket Jump and R Buster Shot are available. Right after Tristana uses W Rocket Jump, block her escape route with Jinx E Flame Chompers! and look for a chance to fight. If a fight is likely, attack minions beforehand to build minigun attack speed stacks.
Tristana.laning: Keep your distance from allied minions to avoid the area damage from Tristana E Explosive Charge. Poke Tristana by hitting a minion beside her with Jinx Q Switcheroo! rockets, and use the minigun for regular last hits to save mana. Pushing the lane toward Tristana's turret makes it harder for her to last hit.
Tristana.phase: Tristana is weak early, but Jinx also isn't a champion who should force an early lane lead, so focus on safe CS and rocket poke. In the mid game, watch for Tristana to push the lane and pressure your turret; if she disappears from vision, check whether she is pushing the turret. Jinx gets stronger as her core items come together in the late game, but a fully built Tristana is still hard to handle, so use earlier opportunities to pressure turrets and close out the game.
Tristana.teamfight: At the start of a teamfight, poke from the edge with Jinx Q Switcheroo! rockets and W Zap!, and don't go in close until it's safe. Save Jinx E Flame Chompers! to stop Tristana W Rocket Jump from engaging. If an ally goes down and Tristana's W Rocket Jump resets, retreat together instead of leaving a squishy ally up front.
Tristana.watch: Don't stand close to allied minions to avoid the area damage from Tristana E Explosive Charge. Tristana W Rocket Jump is a dash that slows, and she can use it again if she gets a takedown, so back off immediately in a fight where an ally goes down. Don't approach carelessly while Tristana R Buster Shot's stun and forced displacement are available.

TwistedFate.combo: Before a fight, use the minigun on minions to build Jinx Q Switcheroo!’s attack speed stacks. Slow him with Jinx W Zap!, then attack with rocket basic attacks while keeping your distance, and switch to the minigun if he gets close. If Twisted Fate R Destiny is down, it will be difficult for him to escape after you root him with Jinx E Flame Chompers!.
TwistedFate.escape: The window to engage opens while Twisted Fate R Destiny, his means of repositioning, is down. If he has also used the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, catch him with Jinx E Flame Chompers! and attack.
TwistedFate.fight: Look to trade when Twisted Fate W Pick a Card’s gold card is down or he is holding a blue or red card. Start with Jinx Q Switcheroo!’s rockets to attack from a distance, then switch to the minigun if he gets close. Twisted Fate has low armor, so Jinx’s primary physical damage is effective against him.
TwistedFate.laning: Early on, focus on safe CS and rocket poke to reach your item timings sooner instead of forcing trades. Use Jinx Q Switcheroo!’s rockets to hit minions beside your opponent for splash damage, but use the minigun for ordinary CS to save mana. Stand behind minions against poke from Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards.
TwistedFate.phase: Jinx is not a champion who gets ahead in lane early, so prioritize safe CS. In the mid game, watch for roams with Twisted Fate R Destiny and use the time while his ultimate is down as an opportunity to fight. In the late game, Jinx grows stronger with core items, and after winning a fight, you can use Jinx P Get Excited! to move on to the next objective.
TwistedFate.teamfight: At the start of a teamfight, poke from the edge with Jinx Q Switcheroo!’s rockets and Jinx W Zap!, and stay out of minigun range until it’s safe. Watch out for the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, and look for a chance to attack after he uses it. If Twisted Fate R Destiny is visible and in range, you can interrupt his movement with Jinx E Flame Chompers!.
TwistedFate.watch: If Twisted Fate is holding a gold card from W Pick a Card, one basic attack will stun you, so stay out of his basic attack range. Stand behind minions to reduce poke damage from Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards.
TwistedFate.build: Jinx prioritizes farming safely and getting her core items. If you build resistance against Twisted Fate’s damage, choose magic resistance over armor.

Twitch.build: Get a Control Ward early to prepare for Twitch Q Ambush’s camouflage. Twitch E Contaminate deals two types of damage, so building only one type of resistance blocks only part of it. Twitch P Deadly Venom’s true damage cannot be reduced by resistance, so account for your total health and, above all, reduce the number of basic attacks you take.
Twitch.combo: Once Twitch’s position is revealed, slow him with Jinx W Zap! and keep your distance with rocket basic attacks from Jinx Q Switcheroo!. If Twitch gets close, place Jinx E Flame Chompers! in his path to root him, then switch Jinx Q Switcheroo! to the minigun and keep attacking. If Twitch flees at a distance after losing health, finish him with Jinx R Super Mega Death Rocket!.
Twitch.escape: Look to engage after Twitch W Venom Cask is down and Twitch Q Ambush’s camouflage breaks, revealing his position. Twitch has no ability to create distance, so you can close in and root him with Jinx E Flame Chompers!.
Twitch.fight: Once Twitch Q Ambush’s camouflage breaks and his position is revealed, slow him with Jinx W Zap! and attack from a distance with Jinx Q Switcheroo!’s rockets. If Twitch gets close, block his path with Jinx E Flame Chompers! and switch Jinx Q Switcheroo! to the minigun to increase your attack speed. Twitch has no ability to create distance, so root him and focus him when you can safely close in.
Twitch.laning: Get a Control Ward to prepare for Twitch Q Ambush’s camouflage, and alert your allies if Twitch disappears from lane. Use Jinx Q Switcheroo!’s rockets to hit minions beside Twitch and poke him with splash damage, but use the minigun to secure ordinary CS and save mana. Early on, focus on safely building CS to reach your item timings sooner instead of forcing trades.
Twitch.phase: Early on, Jinx should focus on rocket poke and safe CS rather than getting ahead in lane. In the mid game, keep vision against Twitch Q Ambush while building items. Jinx grows stronger as she builds core items, and if she takes part in a takedown during a teamfight to trigger Jinx P Get Excited!, she can carry that momentum into the next fight.
Twitch.teamfight: Attack from the edge of teamfights with Jinx Q Switcheroo!’s rockets and Jinx W Zap!, and don’t enter minigun range until it’s safe. When Twitch R Spray and Pray is active, spread out sideways from your allies so you don’t all take his piercing basic attacks. When Twitch Q Ambush’s camouflage breaks and his position is revealed, coordinate with your allies on the target and block his escape route with Jinx E Flame Chompers!.
Twitch.watch: If Twitch Q Ambush makes him disappear from lane, alert your allies, and light up or avoid bushes and narrow paths where you have no vision. If Twitch W Venom Cask lands at your feet, leave immediately to reduce Deadly Venom stacks. After taking several basic attacks, Twitch E Contaminate can finish you off even if you have around half your health, so create distance. When Twitch R Spray and Pray is active, account for its increased range and don’t line up with your allies.

Varus.build: Use Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Prioritize armor since Varus’s main damage is physical and Jinx has relatively low armor.
Varus.combo: First, slow Varus with Jinx W Zap!, then deal damage with rocket basic attacks from Jinx Q Switcheroo! while keeping your distance. If Varus gets close, switch Jinx Q Switcheroo! to the minigun to increase your attack speed. Place Jinx E Flame Chompers! where Varus is approaching or trying to escape to look for a root.
Varus.escape: After Varus R Chain of Corruption is down, look for a chance to close in while dodging his root. You can also dodge sideways out of the path when Varus aims Varus Q Piercing Arrow, then engage. Varus has no ability to create distance, so once you’re close, block his escape with Jinx E Flame Chompers!.
Varus.fight: Early on, focus on safe CS and poke with Jinx Q Switcheroo!’s rockets instead of forcing trades. When Varus aims Varus Q Piercing Arrow, dodge sideways, then look for a chance to engage while he is self-slowed. Once you have closed the distance, use Jinx E Flame Chompers! to keep Varus from escaping.
Varus.laning: Use Jinx Q Switcheroo!’s rockets to hit minions beside Varus and poke him with the splash damage. Use the minigun for ordinary CS to save mana, and find a good time to recall before you run out. If Varus W Blighted Quiver stacks are applied, move out of range of his abilities, then trade again.
Varus.phase: Jinx is not a champion who gets ahead in lane early, so build items with safe CS and rocket poke. In the mid game, keep building Jinx’s core items and don’t force a fight while Varus’s Blighted Quiver stacks are applied. In the late game, Jinx grows stronger with core items, and if a takedown triggers Jinx P Get Excited!, you can turn a won fight into the next objective.
Varus.teamfight: In teamfights, poke from the edge with Jinx Q Switcheroo!’s rockets and Jinx W Zap!, and don’t enter minigun range until it’s safe. Spread out to keep Varus R Chain of Corruption from spreading to your allies. If an ally is killed and Varus P Living Vengeance activates, create some distance for a moment, then fight again.
Varus.watch: When Varus W Blighted Quiver stacks are applied, being hit by one of his abilities deals bonus damage based on your maximum health, so if you’ve taken a few basic attacks, back off and give the stacks time to expire. When you see Varus Q Piercing Arrow aim, dodge sideways out of its path. If an ally is caught by Varus R Chain of Corruption, move away so the tendrils don’t reach you. Healing is also reduced in the area of Varus E Hail of Arrows, so leave it.

Vayne.build: Use Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Prioritize armor against the physical damage from Vayne Q Tumble and Vayne E Condemn. However, armor cannot reduce the true damage from Vayne W Silver Bolts, so don’t try to endure repeated hits.
Vayne.combo: When a fight looks likely, use the minigun on minions to build Jinx Q Switcheroo!’s attack speed stacks in advance. Once Vayne Q Tumble is down, slow her with Jinx W Zap! and block her escape with Jinx E Flame Chompers!. Follow up with rocket basic attacks while keeping your distance, and switch to the minigun if Vayne gets close.
Vayne.escape: The window to block Vayne’s escape and engage with Jinx E Flame Chompers! opens right after Vayne Q Tumble is down. If Vayne E Condemn is still available, don’t approach with your back to a wall. If Vayne chases you, place Jinx E Flame Chompers! behind you in your escape path and slow her with Jinx W Zap!.
Vayne.fight: The window to close in and fight opens right after Vayne uses Vayne Q Tumble. Slow her with Jinx W Zap!, block her escape with Jinx E Flame Chompers!, then attack with rocket basic attacks from Jinx Q Switcheroo! while keeping your distance. If Vayne gets close, switch to the minigun to increase your attack speed.
Vayne.laning: Vayne has low health and armor early, so safely push the lane and disrupt her farming. Use Jinx Q Switcheroo!’s rockets to hit minions beside Vayne and deal splash damage, but use the minigun for ordinary CS to save mana. Poke from a position where you don’t have your back to a wall, and prioritize safe CS over forcing trades.
Vayne.phase: Vayne has low health and armor early, but Jinx also shouldn’t try to get ahead by forcing trades. Disrupt Vayne’s farming with safe rocket poke, and take objectives and turrets in the mid game to reduce the time she has to scale. Jinx grows stronger as she builds core items, but Vayne also becomes difficult to stop with defensive stats in the late game, so turn favorable fights into turrets and objectives.
Vayne.teamfight: Fight in open areas without a wall behind you, and poke from the edge of teamfights with Jinx Q Switcheroo!’s rockets and Jinx W Zap!. Save Jinx E Flame Chompers! for Vayne’s engage, and if she becomes invisible after Vayne Q Tumble during Vayne R Final Hour, use your abilities when she becomes visible again. Don’t move in close with the minigun until it’s safe.
Vayne.watch: Vayne E Condemn stuns you if it knocks you into a wall, so don’t fight with your back to one. Vayne W Silver Bolts deals true damage based on your maximum health after a certain number of attacks hit the same target, so use the range of Jinx Q Switcheroo!’s rockets to create distance just before it triggers. During Vayne R Final Hour, she briefly becomes invisible after Vayne Q Tumble, so hit her with Jinx W Zap! when she becomes visible again.

Xayah.build: Use Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Prioritize armor since Xayah’s main damage is physical and Jinx has relatively low armor.
Xayah.combo: After Xayah R Featherstorm is down, block her escape with Jinx E Flame Chompers! and slow her with Jinx W Zap!. Attack with rocket basic attacks from Jinx Q Switcheroo! while keeping your distance, then switch to the minigun if Xayah gets close.
Xayah.escape: At that point, use Jinx E Flame Chompers! while avoiding the path of returning feathers from Xayah E Bladecaller.
Xayah.fight: Keep trades short while dodging the path of Xayah’s returning feathers.
Xayah.laning: Early on, focus on safe CS and poke with Jinx Q Switcheroo!’s rockets instead of forcing trades. Hit minions beside Xayah with rocket basic attacks to deal splash damage, but use the minigun for ordinary CS to save mana. Poke without letting feathers build up, then change your position.
Xayah.phase: Jinx doesn’t tend to get ahead in lane early, so secure CS safely. In the mid game, build core items while looking for an opportunity after Xayah R Featherstorm is down. In the late game, Jinx grows stronger with core items, and if a takedown triggers Jinx P Get Excited!, she can carry that into the next fight.
Xayah.teamfight: At the start of a teamfight, poke from the edge with Jinx Q Switcheroo!’s rockets and Jinx W Zap!. If Xayah R Featherstorm is available, don’t rush to use Jinx E Flame Chompers!, and stay out of the path of Xayah’s returning feathers. Don’t enter minigun range until it’s safe.
Xayah.watch: Xayah E Bladecaller roots you if you’re hit by three or more returning feathers, so immediately move sideways if feathers are lined up between you and Xayah. Keep trades short, since feathers build up if you fight in the same spot for too long. Don’t rush to use Jinx E Flame Chompers! while Xayah R Featherstorm is available.

Yasuo.build: Start with Cloth Armor for survivability, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Yasuo’s main damage is physical, and Jinx has relatively low armor, so build armor first. However, armor does not block the magic damage from Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Yasuo.combo: After Yasuo W Wind Wall disappears, slow him with Jinx W Zap! and attack from a distance with Jinx Q Switcheroo!’s rocket basic attacks. If Yasuo closes in with E Sweeping Blade, place Jinx E Flame Chompers! in his path, then switch to minigun at close range. Use Jinx R Super Mega Death Rocket! to finish off enemies who have lost health fleeing at a distance rather than firing it right in front of you.
Yasuo.escape: The moment after Yasuo throws the tornado from Q Steel Tempest is your chance to attack. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade comes back quickly, so don’t go in just because he used it once. Before Yasuo R Last Breath comes back, target him with the slow from Jinx W Zap! and the root from Jinx E Flame Chompers! together.
Yasuo.fight: First remove Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield with light poke, then start trading. Right after Yasuo throws the tornado from Q Steel Tempest, he briefly has no way to knock you up, so keep your distance and attack with Jinx Q Switcheroo!’s rockets. If Yasuo gets close, switch Jinx Q Switcheroo! to minigun to increase your attack speed.
Yasuo.laning: Keep the wave thin and pushing toward your side, reducing the number of minions Yasuo E Sweeping Blade can use to ride in. When poking, use Jinx Q Switcheroo!’s rockets to hit minions beside Yasuo, and last-hit normally with the minigun to save mana. Prioritize safe last-hits to reach item timings sooner instead of taking risky trades.
Yasuo.phase: Jinx is not usually ahead in lane during the early game, so focus on safe last-hits and rocket poke. In the mid game, focus on building core items and look for openings when Yasuo’s tornado and W Wind Wall are down. Jinx gets stronger in the late game as core items stack up, and after winning a fight, the movement and attack speed from Jinx P Get Excited! can carry you to the next objective.
Yasuo.watch: Yasuo E Sweeping Blade uses minions as stepping stones to approach, so watch your distance near minions. After Yasuo Q Steel Tempest hits twice, he can knock you up with a tornado, so watch for the sound and visual effect and sidestep out of its path. When Yasuo W Wind Wall appears, it blocks projectiles, so save Jinx W Zap! and Jinx R Super Mega Death Rocket!.

Zeri.build: Use Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Prioritize armor since the main damage from Zeri Q Burst Fire and Zeri W Ultrashock Laser is physical.
Zeri.combo: When a fight looks likely, attack minions to build Jinx Q Switcheroo!’s minigun attack speed stacks in advance. Once Zeri E Spark Surge is down, slow her with Jinx W Zap!, block her escape with Jinx E Flame Chompers!, then follow up with rocket basic attacks. Switch to the minigun if Zeri gets close.
Zeri.escape: Engage right after Zeri E Spark Surge is down. If you also dodge Zeri W Ultrashock Laser, close the distance in open terrain and block Zeri’s escape with Jinx E Flame Chompers!.
Zeri.fight: The window to close in opens right after Zeri uses Zeri E Spark Surge. Slow her with Jinx W Zap! and attack from a distance with Jinx Q Switcheroo!’s rockets, then switch to the minigun if Zeri gets close.
Zeri.laning: Early on, use Jinx Q Switcheroo!’s rockets to hit minions beside Zeri for splash damage while securing CS safely. Take advantage of Zeri’s short basic attack range and low armor, but use the minigun for ordinary CS to save mana.
Zeri.teamfight: Poke from the edge of teamfights with Jinx Q Switcheroo!’s rockets and Jinx W Zap!, and don’t enter minigun range until it’s safe. When Zeri R Lightning Crash is active, don’t chase; block her path with Jinx E Flame Chompers!. Finish off low-health enemies fleeing at a distance with Jinx R Super Mega Death Rocket!.
Zeri.watch: Zeri W Ultrashock Laser spreads out when it hits terrain, so don’t stand with your back to a wall or face her in a narrow passage. Zeri E Spark Surge travels farther when she crosses a wall, so don’t corner her against one. After Zeri R Lightning Crash is active, her movement speed increases, so don’t chase on foot; block her path with Jinx E Flame Chompers!.
Zeri.phase: Early on, safe CS takes priority over forcing trades, but you can use Zeri’s short range to poke with rockets. Build a lead over Zeri before core items are complete, and keep in mind that she’ll become harder to catch because of her mobility afterward. In the late game, Jinx grows stronger with core items, so keep fighting from a safe position.

Ziggs.combo: Before a fight, use the minigun on minions to build Jinx Q Switcheroo!’s attack speed stacks. Once Ziggs W Satchel Charge is down, slow him with Jinx W Zap! and place Jinx E Flame Chompers! in his escape path to look for a root. Attack from a distance with Jinx Q Switcheroo!’s rockets, and switch to the minigun if Ziggs gets close.
Ziggs.escape: The window to engage opens right after Ziggs uses Ziggs W Satchel Charge. Approach along a path without Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield, and block his escape route with Jinx E Flame Chompers!.
Ziggs.fight: Close in after Ziggs uses a set of abilities, especially right after he uses Ziggs W Satchel Charge to poke or clear a wave. Don’t enter through a path covered by Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield, and block Ziggs’s escape with Jinx E Flame Chompers!. Attack from a distance with Jinx Q Switcheroo!’s rockets, and switch to the minigun if Ziggs gets close.
Ziggs.laning: Early on, prioritize safe CS and poke with Jinx Q Switcheroo!’s rockets instead of forcing trades. Hit minions beside Ziggs with rocket basic attacks to deal splash damage, but use the minigun for ordinary CS to save mana. Right after Ziggs W Satchel Charge is down, look for a chance to fight along a path without Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield.
Ziggs.phase: Early on, Jinx should focus on securing CS safely rather than getting ahead in lane. In the mid game, build core items and look for a chance to fight while Ziggs W Satchel Charge is down. In the late game, Jinx grows stronger with core items, and if a takedown triggers Jinx P Get Excited!, you can turn a won fight into the next objective.
Ziggs.teamfight: At the start of a teamfight, poke from the edge with Jinx Q Switcheroo!’s rockets and Jinx W Zap! while staying in a safe position. Avoid paths blocked by Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield, and move away from the center when you see the warning area for Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb. If Ziggs W Satchel Charge is down, block his escape with Jinx E Flame Chompers! to create a chance to finish him.
Ziggs.watch: If you’re caught by Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield, you’ll be slowed and are more likely to get hit by his other abilities, so avoid the mined path or wait until it disappears. When you see the warning area for Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb, move away from the center even if you can’t get completely out of its range. Watch out for the knockback and wall-crossing movement from Ziggs W Satchel Charge while it’s available.
Ziggs.build: Jinx prioritizes farming safely and getting her core items. If you build resistance against Ziggs’s magic damage, choose magic resistance over armor, and consider movement speed so you can walk out of the announced blast area.
